page: Microsoft Azure D48d_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.6 GHz Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor providing 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs via hyperthreading. Cache architecture includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, BMI2, and FMA, supporting accelerated vector and cryptographic processing.

The virtual machine features 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced general-purpose allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark evaluations place memory subsystem throughput in the upper tier, with PassMark memory testing reaching 2810.62 (top 25%). Synthetic memory bandwidth registers 2492.11 GB/sec for cached 16 KB read blocks, 170.7 GB/sec for large 256 MB read blocks, and 70.1 GB/sec for large block writes. The instance does not include a discrete GPU, but bundles 1933 GB of local SSD storage directly on the host.

Compute and application benchmarks reflect steady mid-tier capability across multi-core workloads. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 35075.75 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11424.0. Single-core results show a Geekbench score of 1322.0 and a stress-ng score of 1414.38. In application-focused metrics, the D48d_v4 sustains 40.98 million Redis SET operations per second, a clang compilation score of 31227.0, and static web serving throughput of 27.62 GB/sec. However, raw language model text generation throughput is constrained by CPU inference limits, landing in the bottom quartile across test sizes.

From a cost-efficiency and architectural standpoint, the D48d_v4 delivers balanced compute, high-throughput memory, and bundled high-capacity local SSD storage without separate disk attachment overhead. It is well configured for enterprise database operations, caching layers, software compilation, ETL pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving environments requiring fast local temporary storage.
description: Microsoft Azure D48d_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor running at 2.6 GHz across 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores). Designed with a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, it supplies 192.0 GB of RAM alongside 1933 GB of integrated local SSD storage. The CPU supports AVX-512 and VNNI instructions for vector workloads, while benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier memory performance alongside solid mid-tier multi-threaded compute results. Application testing demonstrates 40.98 million Redis SET operations per second and 27.62 GB/sec in static web serving. While unsuited for heavy language model text generation due to the absence of hardware accelerators, the bundled high-speed local disk and robust memory subsystem make the instance effective for database hosting, continuous integration build jobs, transactional caching layers, and enterprise web serving workloads.
